desc:
💣 HIDE AND SEEK... BUT THE SEEKERS FLY EXPLODING DRONES 💥

One team hides. The other flies FPV drones and hunts them through windows, doors and walls. Up to 12 players. Playing alone? Bots fill the lobby, no waiting!

🏃 SURVIVORS: sprint, vault, crouch and hide. Shoot drones down, set traps and decoys, find secret hideaways.
🚁 PILOTS: fly first-person drones, use abilities and strike.
💥 Walls break, floors collapse, whole buildings fall. No hiding spot is safe.

🗺️ Map vote: LUMIERE, FREIGHT YARD, HILL VILLAGE, OAKRIDGE
🎲 Round twists: Blackout, Tiny Hiders, Low Gravity & more
🚀 60+ drones, each with its own stats and abilities
🎁 Daily rewards, a free daily spin and a parkour course

🎉 1,000 PLAYERS AT ONCE. THANK YOU!
🌟 NEW CODE: 1KPLAYERS (250 free Points!)
🎟️ More codes: DRONE20, BREACH, PUMPKIN30
Redeem them in PASSES & BOOSTS > SUPPORT.
⭐ Favorite the game so you can find it again!

Passes never change drone speed, damage or vision.
